reply.text:
Being the smaller one in the group is really common at twelve. Kids grow at very different times, and it says nothing about how strong you'll end up.

At your age, getting strong is mostly about learning good movement and building the habit. Bodyweight work like push-ups, squats, and pull-ups or rows gets you a long way. Add sports or games you enjoy, eat regular meals with enough protein, and sleep a lot, because that's when you grow and get stronger. Light weights are fine if a coach or parent is there to teach you the technique, but you don't need to go heavy.

Because you're under 18, the app doesn't build programs or targets for you. Ask a parent, a PE teacher, or a coach at school to show you the basics. I'm happy to talk through how any exercise should feel, or what a good week of sports and play looks like.
